findings.current: Arrows were flying toward him, weaving around the fanatics as though they were alive.
findings.defect: The translation omits the image of the arrows reflected in the old man's aged gray eyes.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly describes what appears in his 노회한 회색빛 눈동자—his aged gray eyes. The accepted baseline preserves that physical detail; the assembled version drops it.
findings.replacement: Reflected in his aged gray eyes were arrows flying toward him, weaving around the fanatics as though they were alive.

findings.current: If the Doppelganger, calling itself the Prophet, was their spiritual pillar, the old man was the warrior chief favored by God—the general who led them.
findings.defect: “Calling itself” adds that the Doppelganger named or presented itself as the Prophet. The source says it served as their spiritual pillar under the Prophet's name, without specifying that act.
findings.rationale: The Korean says 도플갱어가 선지자라는 이름으로 정신적인 지주의 역할을 했다면: the Doppelganger served as their spiritual pillar in the name of the Prophet. It does not establish that the Doppelganger called itself that.
findings.replacement: If the Doppelganger, under the name of the Prophet, was their spiritual pillar, the old man was the warrior chief favored by God—the general who led them.

summary: The assembled chapter is largely faithful. Two minor details remain: an omitted physical description and an added implication about the Doppelganger.
